product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI provides an AI super assistant and agentic platform that automates knowledge work and builds applications for professionals and enterprises.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts by the research team cover LLM training techniques, forecasting models, neural architectures and open-source research.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes multiple guides for agents, application building, tasks and the SuperComputer.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists Software Engineer - Generative AI and Research Scientist roles.

model_provider.value: GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1 and Grok 4.6.
model_provider.notes: These are examples named in the ChatLLM help guide; RouteLLM can automatically select among supported models.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page displays SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 badges and describes standards alignment. The security paper explicitly claims HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS v3.2.1 compliance. These are public claims, not independent verification of certification.

last_funding.notes: The latest dated announcement found, February 12, 2026, reports $50 million in additional funding without naming a stage. Forge separately lists a $55.5 million Series C-1 dated December 4, 2025; the sources do not establish whether these describe the same financing.

raised_18mo.notes: Both the February 2026 funding announcement and Forge's December 2025 financing record fall within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists Junior Sales Development Representative (Jr SDR).

launched_6mo.notes: On September 10, 2026, Abacus.AI announced Smaug Agentic, Smaug Flash and Smaug Mini, within the requested six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated executive hire or departure was verified for the requested window. Thodoris Petropoulos began a VP role in February 2026, but his profile shows an internal promotion rather than joining the company.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting names Outreach and Salesloft. Salesforce is a documented integration, which does not by itself establish internal CRM deployment.
